summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, client_secret, client_id, http_path; secret fields client_id and client_secret; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var references for both secrets). Registered it in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings and in __all__, and exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim checks, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile and env-var output, and profile-arg override protection. Tests were not run and nothing was committed. One item to check: env_vars values read profile args first via base get_dbt_value, so a caller-supplied client_id or client_secret in profile args would change the env-var values; I did not add custom handling since the spec forbids extra validation.
